New
• Tick a task and it does what the phone does: a green "Moving to Done in 3s · UNDO" chip counts down (the phone's delay for that tab), then a green tick pops over the card, it shrinks away and the gap closes. Nothing is saved until the countdown ends; UNDO or unticking keeps it. Works in all four designs, in Buy, the Today Hub and Calls.
• Untick in Done and the card slides out and comes back in Active with a short glow. The Active / Done count pops.
• With the phone's delay Off, the tick plays at once and a "Moved to Done · Undo" snackbar follows.
